scope: Campaign prerequisites, never execution or complete acceptance proof. Every permanent family keeps its full manual requirement and subcases.

INT.prerequisites: Exact candidate APK/package/signing identity, populated upgrade snapshots and disposable native runtime; use the real startup failure/loading/upgrade states.

ONB.prerequisites: Disposable fresh install, synthetic keys and controlled relay success/failure; signer, QR scanning and actual setup/import success require their own fixtures.

ACC.prerequisites: Three generated identities plus populated distinct histories; account deletion/signout, switching during work and persistent isolation need native state proof.

NAV.prerequisites: Real app destinations and nested dialog stacks; warm resume, recreation, process death and pending-work return are separate lifecycle campaigns.

CHL.prerequisites: Empty and populated account projections, unread/pinned/folder state and controlled incoming activity; verify persistence and account isolation, not only row labels.

NCH.prerequisites: Synthetic known/unknown contacts, loopback discovery/invitations and actual group/direct-chat creation; cancellation alone does not prove published membership.

GRP.prerequisites: Generated members/admins and controlled invites, removal, stale membership and recovery; use bounded native peer proof for every membership mutation.

CON.prerequisites: Real empty/populated/long conversation timelines, composer geometry and peer events; audio, attachment playback and interrupted operations need dedicated media/device fixtures.

MSG.prerequisites: Real outgoing/incoming/native messages, reactions and polls; distinguish cancellation from published edits, deletion, reports, forwarding and concurrent peer results.

MED.prerequisites: Real system pickers plus controlled attachment corruption, size, transfer, retry, storage and lifecycle fixtures; camera/microphone/audio hardware remains a physical campaign.

FIND.prerequisites: Controlled contact/history/date datasets, invalid identifiers and timezone boundaries; staged date-chip UI is not evidence of native search or daylight-saving semantics.

SET.prerequisites: Every SettingsDetail route, nested controls and persisted preferences; external Android destinations, release-only controls and notifications need appropriate installed-platform state.

PRO.prerequisites: Synthetic self/peer metadata, private notes, photos and known invalid fields; native persistence/publication, image cropping and cross-account visibility need real postconditions.

SEC.prerequisites: Disposable identity, biometric enrollment/lockout, screenshots/clipboard and backup fixtures; never treat hidden-key navigation or cancelled export as cryptographic/export proof.

NTF.prerequisites: Fresh-install notification flags plus real channels, peer events, foreground/background state and Android overrides; an allowed permission is not delivery or alert-quality proof.

TTS.prerequisites: Rate/voice/engine dialogs plus installed trusted/untrusted engines and controlled timelines; measure actual audio/highlights/seeking/interruptions rather than certifying sound from a UI control.

DIC.prerequisites: Real provider chooser plus installed service/activity/IME providers, microphone access, delayed callbacks and target-loss fixtures; cancellation does not prove recognition or immutable-origin delivery.

AXY.prerequisites: Theme/RTL/large-font/layout variants plus real TalkBack, Switch Access and keyboard traversal; accessible labels or screenshots alone cannot certify focus order or announcements.

SYS.prerequisites: Disposable share intents, files/providers, installer/self-update and release identity; startup, corrupt import and interrupted install require their actual platform entry points.

FLD.prerequisites: Generated conversations, basic/smart folders and rule boundaries; verify folder store persistence and native matching independently of editor cancellation.

RDR.prerequisites: Controlled Nostr event/link/media content, unavailable relays, reader selection and navigation; reserved-domain link text does not exercise actual event/video reader acquisition.

END.prerequisites: Exact-source reports from every required layer, all failures/unexecuted points and justified inapplicability; final certification must reconcile those reports and remaining checklist subcases.
